summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 of the cipher-box project: expand E2E test coverage (account cleanup helpers, media/streaming tests, batch download tests) and capture staging performance baselines (journey timing, load testing, BYO-IPFS/Pinata capacity ceiling).
summary.outcome: All 4 plans executed — 34-01 (cleanup helpers wired into 10 specs), 34-02 (16 new media/streaming tests), 34-03 (5 batch download tests), and 34-04 partially complete (BYO load test plan updated to ACTIVE, journey timing baselines captured, SDK load tests throttle-limited). Phase verification not yet run due to pending 34-04 completion.

repo: Playwright config does not respect BASE_URL env var by default — requires explicit `process.env.BASE_URL` override and conditional webServer skip when targeting staging.
Web3Auth SDK initialization takes >20s on staging, causing tests with 20s timeout on wallet-login-button to fail consistently against staging.
Cleanup helper `deleteAccountViaPage` used hardcoded localhost:3000 for API URL — must derive API URL from the page's current origin when running against staging.
Vitest in tests/load does not auto-load .env files — requires explicit shell env sourcing (`. tests/load/.env`) before running vitest.
The SDK load test harness does not forward THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET during createTestAccount, causing staging rate limiter to block bulk account creation (190/200 accounts 429'd).
LOAD_TEST_CLIENTS=200 on staging is effectively throttle-capped to ~10 clients without bypass header support in the account creation path.
The byo-capacity-ceiling scenario already supports stepwise scaling (50→100→200→500→1000 clients) against Pinata via BYO_IPFS_PROTOCOL=pinata.
Default Pinata endpoint is https://api.pinata.cloud — auth uses Bearer JWT in Authorization header via PinataProvider.

code.finding: waitFor timeout was 20_000ms — too short for Web3Auth on staging; increased to accommodate slower init.
Config lacked BASE_URL env var support and webServer conditional — both added to enable staging runs without local dev server.
API URL derived from hardcoded localhost:3000 — fixed to infer from page URL so cleanup works on staging.
No dotenv loading configured; Vite's loadEnv is not available in plain vitest context — env must be sourced at shell level.
Plan was committed with DEFERRED status (no Pinata account assumed); updated to ACTIVE after user confirmed Pinata credentials available.

workflow: GSD worktree agents commit to isolated branches — orchestrator must cherry-pick commits to phase branch manually, handling STATE.md conflicts by taking worktree version.
When multiple agents write to STATE.md in the same phase, cherry-pick conflicts are expected and resolved by accepting the most recent worktree's version.
Vitest's `loadEnv` from Vite is not directly importable in vitest config — shell-level env sourcing (`. .env && npx vitest`) is the simplest workaround.
Running SDK-level load tests (200 clients) concurrent with browser load tests (5 clients) against the same staging instance causes throttle amplification.
Browser Playwright load tests with 5 clients × ~70 ops hit a 10-minute timeout ceiling — useful for contention data but not throughput baselines.

friction: BASE_URL env var not respected by Playwright config out of the box — caused full test suite failure on first staging run before fix.
Web3Auth >20s init time on staging caused journey-timing test to timeout silently with a blank page screenshot, requiring MCP browser inspection to diagnose.
Git index.lock contention when 34-02 and 34-03 agents ran in parallel — 34-03 had to be retried after manual lock cleanup.
Vitest does not auto-load .env — discovered only after BYO capacity ceiling test ran with all BYO tests skipped due to missing env vars.
THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET not forwarded during SDK test account creation — staging rate limiter blocked 190/200 clients, invalidating the 200-client baseline.
Cherry-picking from multiple worktree branches with STATE.md conflicts required multiple stash/unstash cycles and manual conflict resolution.
